_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(w): "contribution by an employee of the Central Government to an additional account referred to in section 20(3) of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 2013 (23 of 2013) of the pension scheme notified by the Central Government, as referred to in section 124 (a) for a fixed period of not less than three years; and (b) which is as per the scheme as may be notified by the Central Government for the purposes of this clause" (Gazette 265620, p.563). D-130. A fixed period of not less than three years — an entry condition. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(xxv) (egazette 2019/209695, Finance (No. 2) Act, 2019 s.23, p.16): "being an employee of the Central Government, as a contribution to a specified account of the pension scheme referred to in section 80CCD", for not less than three years under a notified scheme. sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md; D-144.
